original_card.question: What exact content and credit of a small named PR set has already been retained?
methods: Compare exact heads and retained artifacts to write a source-bound disposition receipt.
Audit an existing receipt for missing content or predecessor attribution.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Separate complete integration, partial retention and changed heads; make no autonomous closures.

first_step.inspect: Read one small PR set in the ledger and identify exact reviewed heads and unresolved content.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Compare that set to retained artifacts; produce a complete or explicitly partial disposition receipt.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Reliable overlap evidence preserves credit and prevents repeated review of already-retained material.
allowed_variations: One small related PR family or one existing integration receipt.
scope_change_triggers: Treating matching titles or one shared blob as proof of full incorporation.

actual_scope: Authenticate PR211's complete 25-path/13-direct-file source retention across incorporated PR205, PR210 and PR217, reconcile its 6,191 frame bases, Round-9 replay certificate and child-histogram delta, and restore missing PR211 credit in CONTRIBUTORS.md.
scope_change_reason: Narrow the overlap-receipt card to PR211 (rohanarun, c63e50a5dde96fe1459d6b29e55e47f42f104347) and its parent/downstream next100 packages (#205, #210, #217); no selected-frontier change or new physical replay.
bottleneck_link: Resolve a concrete missing retention and attribution link for PR211's 6,191 cascade-optimized frame bases so review can reuse the exact authenticated source and Round-9 replay record without confusing retention with proof acceptance.
stop_rule: Stop after the complete 25-path/13-direct-file Git identity, 6,191-frame inventory, Round-9 replay certificate reconciliation, child-histogram delta accounting and failure controls are established; do not rerun the full historical construction or search for a new circuit.
evidence: SOURCE-PROOF.json, RESULT.json, verify.py, test_verify.py; source retention and saved-certificate accounting only.
author: steph4n (@steph4n-gh)
ai_assistance: Substantial Google Gemini assistance in investigation, implementation, verification and writing; no independent human review claimed.
seed_use: Assigned consolidation track and overlap-receipt task; selected historical PR211 among starting-snapshot partially_reviewed PRs lacking ledger integration pointers.
no_open_questions_reason: All 25 changed paths (12 inherited from PR205 and 13 direct files) and the 6,191 frame bases are accounted for and reconciled with the Round-9 certificate; no further source-retention experiment is justified. Inherited compiler, selector, routing, precision and formal proof obligations remain outside this receipt.

overlap_at_entry.limits: Remote PR scope is open PRs including drafts. Closed work is searched through local READMEs, TASK metadata and ledger only. No code diffs or arbitrary package files are searched. Recheck relevant heads before submission.
overlap_at_entry.finding: No open PR or discussion claims PR211 source retention or CONTRIBUTORS.md attribution repair.

overlap_before_submission.limits: Remote PR scope is open PRs including drafts. Closed work is searched through local READMEs, TASK metadata and ledger only. No code diffs or arbitrary package files are searched. Recheck relevant heads before submission.
overlap_before_submission.finding: Only this package's own README/TASK metadata and coordination claim match PR211 retention; no competing contribution observed.
